capabilities.name: Unlock framerate
capabilities.summary: Skips the normal extra VBlank wait, either globally or only in battle.
touches: ARM9 helper cave for battle-only mode
caveats: Global mode affects more game contexts than battle-only mode.
examplePrompts: Make battles run closer to 60 FPS.
Unlock the framerate only during battles.

capabilities.name: Shiny odds
capabilities.summary: Changes the ARM9 shiny personality threshold using an integer percent from 0 to 100.
caveats: 100 percent shiny odds can stall event or gift routines that explicitly reroll until non-shiny.

capabilities.name: No critical hits
capabilities.summary: Makes the battle critical-hit multiplier routine return no critical hit.
caveats: Does not change move descriptions or UI text.
examplePrompts: Remove critical hits from the game.

capabilities.name: Random IV range
capabilities.summary: Rerolls generated IV values until they land inside a configured inclusive range.
caveats: Extreme narrow ranges reroll more often and may make generation slower.
examplePrompts: Make every generated Pokemon have IVs from 15 to 31.
Make all generated Pokemon perfect IVs.

capabilities.name: Filter wild natures
capabilities.summary: Restricts wild Pokemon nature generation to a selected list of nature ids.
touches: overlay 6 wild encounter nature generation routine
caveats: Synchronize no longer forces banned wild natures.
examplePrompts: Only allow Adamant and Jolly wild Pokemon.
Remove bad natures from wild encounters.

capabilities.name: Faster movement
capabilities.summary: Speeds up player walking, running, and cycling by editing player movement constants.
caveats: This is player-scoped and does not globally change all NPC movement tables.

capabilities.name: Fairy Patch
capabilities.summary: Replaces the ??? type slot with Fairy battle logic and visual assets.
caveats: Pokemon type updates are separate; use fairyPokemonTypes too if desired.
examplePrompts: Add the Fairy type to Platinum.

capabilities.name: Update Pokemon Types
capabilities.summary: Updates selected Kanto-Sinnoh base-form Pokemon personal-data type bytes for the Fairy Patch.
caveats: Automatically also applies fairyType. Altaria is intentionally unchanged because Platinum has no Mega Evolution form.
examplePrompts: Add Fairy type and update Pokemon types.

capabilities.name: Force fast text
capabilities.summary: Applies the fastest normal field and battle text speed edits.
caveats: For multi-character-per-frame text, use text4x instead.

capabilities.name: Experimental text speed
capabilities.summary: Hooks the async text printer to render multiple normal characters per frame.
caveats: Callback-driven text falls back to one render per frame; timing quirks are possible.
examplePrompts: Set dialogue to 10 characters per frame.

capabilities.name: Player accuracy bypass
capabilities.summary: Skips standard accuracy miss handling for player-side attackers.
caveats: Does not remove type immunities, Protect, or semi-invulnerable state checks.
